name: ZX_EVNT_CLS_MAPPINGS
description: This table stores mappings of tax event classes to application event classes of Oracle Applications.

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Application event class code

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Application identifier

columns.name: ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Entity code for this application event class

columns.name: TAX_EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Tax event class code

columns.name: RECORD_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether tax lines for this event class are recorded in the tax repository

columns.name: DET_FACTOR_TEMPL_CODE
columns.description: Determining factor template to be used for tax regime determination for this event class

columns.name: DEFAULT_ROUNDING_LEVEL_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate the default level of rounding for this event class. Possible values are LINE and HEADER.

columns.name: ROUNDING_LEVEL_HIER_1_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate the first precedence for level of rounding for this event class

columns.name: ROUNDING_LEVEL_HIER_2_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate the second precedence for level of rounding for this event class

columns.name: ROUNDING_LEVEL_HIER_3_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate the third precedence for level of rounding for this event class

columns.name: ROUNDING_LEVEL_HIER_4_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate the fourth precedence for level of rounding for this event class

columns.name: ALLOW_MANUAL_LIN_RECALC_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates if the tax is recalculated for manually entered tax lines of this event class

columns.name: ALLOW_OVERRIDE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates if the user is allowed to override tax calculated by the system for this event class

columns.name: ALLOW_MANUAL_LINES_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates if the user is allowed to manually eneter tax lines for this event class

columns.name: PERF_ADDNL_APPL_FOR_IMPRT_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates if additional applicability is performed for imported documents of this event class

columns.name: SHIP_TO_PARTY_TYPE
columns.description: Source of the ship to party for this event class

columns.name: SHIP_FROM_PARTY_TYPE
columns.description: Source of the ship from party for this event class

columns.name: POA_PARTY_TYPE
columns.description: Source of the point of acceptance party for this event class

columns.name: POO_PARTY_TYPE
columns.description: Source of the point of order party for this event class

columns.name: PAYING_PARTY_TYPE
columns.description: Source of the paying party for this event class

columns.name: OWN_HQ_PARTY_TYPE
columns.description: Source of the own HQ party for this event class

columns.name: TRAD_HQ_PARTY_TYPE
columns.description: Source of the trading HQ party for this event class

columns.name: POI_PARTY_TYPE
columns.description: Source of the point of inventory party for this event class

columns.name: POD_PARTY_TYPE
columns.description: Source of the point of destination party for this event class

columns.name: BILL_TO_PARTY_TYPE
columns.description: Source of the bill to party for this event class

columns.name: BILL_FROM_PARTY_TYPE
columns.description: Source of the bill from party for this event class

columns.name: TTL_TRNS_PARTY_TYPE
columns.description: Source of the title transfer party for this event class

columns.name: MERCHANT_PARTY_TYPE
columns.description: Source of the merchant party for this event class

columns.name: SHIP_TO_PTY_SITE_TYPE
columns.description: Source of the ship to party site for this event class

columns.name: SHIP_FROM_PTY_SITE_TYPE
columns.description: Source of the ship from party site for this event class

columns.name: POA_PTY_SITE_TYPE
columns.description: Source of the point of acceptance party site for this event class

columns.name: POO_PTY_SITE_TYPE
columns.description: Source of the point of order party site for this event class

columns.name: PAYING_PTY_SITE_TYPE
columns.description: Source of the paying party site for this event class

columns.name: OWN_HQ_PTY_SITE_TYPE
columns.description: Source of the own HQ party site for this event class

columns.name: TRAD_HQ_PTY_SITE_TYPE
columns.description: Source of the trading HQ party site for this event class

columns.name: POI_PTY_SITE_TYPE
columns.description: Source of the point of inventory party site for this event class

columns.name: POD_PTY_SITE_TYPE
columns.description: Source of the point of destination party site for this event class

columns.name: BILL_TO_PTY_SITE_TYPE
columns.description: Source of the bill to party site for this event class

columns.name: BILL_FROM_PTY_SITE_TYPE
columns.description: Source of the bill from party site for this event class

columns.name: TTL_TRNS_PTY_SITE_TYPE
columns.description: Source of the title transfer party site for this event class

columns.name: ENFORCE_TAX_FROM_ACCT_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether the tax associated with the natural account segment is enforced for this event class

columns.name: OFFSET_TAX_BASIS_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code for tax basis used in offset tax calculation for this event class

columns.name: REFERENCE_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Not currently used

columns.name: PROD_FAMILY_GRP_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate the product family of this event class. Possible values are P2P and O2C

columns.name: ALLOW_OFFSET_TAX_CALC_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether offset taxes are determined for this event class. This is applicable only if this event class belongs to the procure to pay product family

columns.name: SELF_ASSESS_TAX_LINES_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether the self assessment is done for this event class. This is applicable only if this event class belongs to the procure to pay product family

columns.name: TAX_RECOVERY_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether tax recovery is determined for this event class

columns.name: ALLOW_CANCEL_TAX_LINES_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether the user can be allowed to cancel tax lines for this event class. This is applicable only if this event class belongs to the procure to pay product family

columns.name: ALLOW_MAN_TAX_ONLY_LINES_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates if the user is allowed to manually enter tax only lines for this event class. This is applicable only if this event class belongs to the procure to pay product family

columns.name: TAX_VARIANCE_CALC_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates if tax variances are determined for this event class

columns.name: ENABLE_MRC_FLAG
columns.description: Not currently used

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: TAX_REPORTING_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates if tax needs to be reported for this event class

columns.name: ENTER_OVRD_INCL_TAX_LINES_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether the user is allowed to enter or override inclusive tax lines for this event class

columns.name: CTRL_EFF_OVRD_CALC_LINES_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates if all impacted system tax lines are recalculated for this event class, when there is an override on a inclusive tax line

columns.name: SUMMARIZATION_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates if summary tax lines are determined for this event class

columns.name: RETAIN_SUMM_TAX_LINE_ID_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether existing summary tax line identifier is retained for this event class

columns.name: RECORD_FOR_PARTNERS_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether this event class is recorded in repositories of external service providers

columns.name: MANUAL_LINES_FOR_PARTNER_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether for this event class, the user is allowed to manually enter tax lines for tax regimes subscribed to external service providers

columns.name: MAN_TAX_ONLY_LIN_FOR_PTNR_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether for this event class, the user is allowed to manually enter tax only lines for tax regimes subscribed to external service providers

columns.name: ALWAYS_USE_EBTAX_FOR_CALC_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether eBusiness Tax always determines taxes for this event class inspite of any subscriptions to external service providers

columns.name: PROCESSING_PRECEDENCE
columns.description: Order in which this event class is processed for tax calculation, when multiple event classes are processed at the same time

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_MAPPING_ID
columns.description: Event class mapping identifier

columns.name: ENFORCE_TAX_FROM_REF_DOC_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether this event class checks that tax name on the event class line is same as tax name on the corresponding reference document line.

columns.name: PROCESS_FOR_APPLICABILITY_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether taxes should be automatically calculated for this event class or not

columns.name: DISPLAY_USER_KEY1_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates if user key 1 is displayed on Additional Tax Information page/window for this event class

columns.name: DISPLAY_USER_KEY2_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates if user key 2 is displayed on Additional Tax Information page/window for this event class

columns.name: DISPLAY_USER_KEY3_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates if user key 3 is displayed on Additional Tax Information page/window for this event class

columns.name: DISPLAY_USER_KEY4_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates if user key 4 is displayed on Additional Tax Information page/window for this event class

columns.name: DISPLAY_USER_KEY5_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates if user key 5 is displayed on Additional Tax Information page/window for this event class

columns.name: DISPLAY_USER_KEY6_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates if user key 6 is displayed on Additional Tax Information page/window for this event class

columns.name: ALLOW_EXEMPTIONS_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether exemptions are allowed for this event class

columns.name: SUP_CUST_ACCT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate whether the third party information represents supplier or customer for this event class. Possible values are SUPPLIER and CUSTOMER.

columns.name: DISPLAY_TAX_CLASSIF_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates if tax classification code is displayed on Additional Tax Information page/window for this event class

columns.name: INTGRTN_DET_FACTORS_UI_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates if this event class is integrated with the Additional Tax Information page/window

columns.name: INTRCMP_TX_EVNT_CLS_CODE
columns.description: Intercompany tax event class code for this event class

columns.name: INTRCMP_SRC_ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Intercompany source document entity code for this event class

columns.name: INTRCMP_SRC_EVNT_CLS_CODE
columns.description: Intercompany source document event class code for this event class

columns.name: INTRCMP_SRC_APPLN_ID
columns.description: Intercompany source document application identifier for this event class

columns.name: ALLOW_TAX_PARAM_EXTN_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether tax parameter extension is allowed for this event class

columns.name: ALLOW_USER_API_EXTN_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether user api extension is allowed for this event class

columns.name: LOGICAL_TAX_POINT_BASIS
columns.description: Logical Tax Point Basis for this event class.

columns.name: REF_EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Reference Event Class to which the user defined event class is mapped.

columns.name: ACCT_REP_TREATMENT_CODE
columns.description: Column to indicate accounting and reporting treatment for the external transactions.

columns.name: INCLUSIVE_TREATMENT_CODE
columns.description: Column to indicate if item distribution needs to be adjusted for inclusive tax calculation.

columns.name: INDIRECT_TAX_OR_WHT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the event class mapping is for indirect tax (I) or withholding tax (W).

columns.name: ENFORCE_TAX_POINT_BASIS_FLAG
columns.description: Yes or No indicates whether all tax lines should have the same tax point basis as the logical tax point basis on event class.

columns.name: ENABLE_CALC_FOR_JRNL_LN_FLAG
columns.description: Yes or No indicates if tax calculation for journal lines is enabled.

columns.name: ENABLE_INCL_TAX_CALC_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether inclusive tax calculation will be performed for an event class. Valid values: Y and N.

columns.name: WHT_CALC_POINT_FLAG
columns.description: Point at which withholding tax is applied. Possible values are I for invoice, P for payment, B for both, and N for never.

columns.name: DEFAULTING_TEMPLATE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the defaulting template associated with an application event class.

columns.name: TAX_AUTH_INV_CREATION_POINT
columns.description: Point at which a withholding tax authority invoice is created.  Possible values are I for invoice and P for payment.

columns.name: WHT_CASH_DISCOUNT_APPL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the discount amount is included in withholding tax calculation. Valid values: Y and N.

columns.name: TRX_TAX_WHT_APPLICABILITY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the tax amount is included in the withholding tax calculation. Valid values: Y and N.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
